Weekend notice for pet owners
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Weekend Watch for Pet Travelers

Travelers flying with pets need to check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before heading to the gate, because weekend handling is busy and small details can slip. Please keep pet carriers closed, labeled, and easy to inspect, and have any needed papers ready when you arrive.

Handlers are using calm, humane methods around animals, and they are keeping an eye on each pet's comfort during movement through the airport. The welfare coordinator is reviewing care needs case by case, while the passenger coordinator is still giving out the steps that travelers need to follow. This helps the crews stay ready and keeps the process steady for everyone involved.

If you are traveling with a pet today, please listen closely to the desk instructions and let us know right away if your animal seems stressed, overheated, or unwell. We are sharing practical guidance with crews and making sure the right notes follow each booking.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you move on.
